What really happened inside the house that became known worldwide as the Bothell Hell House—and why did one television investigation leave so many people questioning the truth?

In a compelling new episode of The Paranormal Chronicles Podcast, bestselling paranormal author and host G. L. Davies speaks with Keith Linder, the man at the centre of one of America’s most controversial alleged hauntings.

After moving into a seemingly ordinary home in Bothell, Washington, Linder says he endured four years of escalating paranormal activity. His disturbing account includes unexplained fires, Bibles reportedly disappearing, burning or being torn apart, threatening symbols appearing on walls, physical attacks and destructive poltergeist phenomena. What began as unsettling incidents developed into an ordeal that would affect his home, his relationship, and his reputation.

LISTEN TO THE FULL ACCOUNT HERE > https://open.spotify.com/episode/5lsXXgYoEiNMqePzgPL7S7

The case attracted international attention when Ghost Adventures investigated the property for its “Demons in Seattle” episode. When the team failed to capture convincing evidence during filming, public opinion turned sharply against Linder. Accusations of fakery followed—but was a brief television investigation enough to dismiss years of reported activity and extensive documentation?

In this unmissable interview, Linder confronts the Ghost Adventures controversy, reveals what he believes the programme failed to show and discusses the evidence examined by subsequent investigators. He also explains the human cost of public disbelief and online abuse after sharing his story with the world.

Was the Bothell case an elaborate hoax, a misunderstood haunting or one of the most significant poltergeist cases ever documented? Hear the testimony, examine the controversy and decide for yourself.

This is paranormal testimony at its most disturbing, personal and disputed.
